response.sql: WITH filtered_runs AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, sp.memusagegb, sp.procgpu, sp.proccpu FROM scanprocessing sp INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8), site_averages AS (SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(memusagegb) as avg_ram, AVG(CASE WHEN proccpu IS NOT NULL AND proccpu != 0 AND procgpu IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(procgpu AS FLOAT) / CAST(proccpu AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM filtered_runs GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) as avg_of_site_rams, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) as avg_of_site_ratios FROM site_averages GROUP BY entrystat;
